summary: BlueSky Software and Sega's late-era Genesis action-platformer series, known for pre-rendered 3D-style character animation and abandoned attempts at a third entry.

entries.title: Vectorman
entries.definitive_edition: SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online release

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Switch Online Genesis app or Genesis Plus GX
emulation.notes: Use Switch Online for modern save/rewind convenience; PC Sega Classics is a good owned-copy capture fallback.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Genesis/Mega Drive presentation with official emulator features.

primary.version: SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online release
primary.why: The first Vectorman is currently available through Nintendo Classics/Switch Online, with modern save/rewind/online-share features and Switch 2 compatibility support, making it the best current official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play through the SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online app with an Expansion Pack membership. Use an owned PC Sega Classics copy or original Genesis cartridge only for alternate access.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is official emulation of the Genesis release, not a remaster.

entries.title: Vectorman 2

emulation.emulator: Sega Classics wrapper or Genesis Plus GX
emulation.notes: Use PC Sega Classics if owned; otherwise use original Genesis or Genesis Mini 2.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Genesis/Mega Drive presentation with emulator scaling.

primary.version: SEGA Mega Drive and Genesis Classics / owned Steam release
primary.why: Vectorman 2 remains a Genesis-only sequel with official compilation and Sega Classics rereleases; the owned PC Sega Classics route is the most capture-flexible main route when available.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PC Sega Classics copy for capture if available. Otherwise use the original Genesis cartridge, Sega Genesis Mini 2, or a console compilation that includes Vectorman 2.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an emulated Genesis release, not a remaster. Multiple Vectorman 3 attempts were cancelled and are not playable official entries.
